title: Daily Devotional #47
paragraphs: Today I opened my Bible to Luke 3, and I was struck by the powerful message of John the Baptist. John preached a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins and called the people to prepare the way for the Lord. His message was not only for the common people but also for the tax collectors and soldiers, telling them to be honest and not to extort money.

As I read through the chapter, I was reminded of the importance of repentance and the need to prepare myself for your coming. John’s message was not just a call to be sorry for our sins but also to turn away from them and to live a life that is pleasing to you.

Lord, I confess that there are times when I fall short of your glory and sin against you. I pray that you would help me to be quick to repent and turn back to you. I also pray that you would help me to prepare my heart for your coming. May I be ready and waiting for you when you return.

Furthermore, I was amazed to see the genealogy of Jesus in Luke 3. It reminds me of how you work through generations and how you keep your promises. Your plan was set in motion long before Jesus’ birth, and your plan continues to unfold in my life and the lives of those around me.

Lord, I am grateful for the gift of salvation through Jesus Christ. I am also grateful for the work you are doing in my life and in the lives of those around me. Help me to trust in your plan and to be faithful in following you.
Thank you for your Word, which reminds me of your love and your faithfulness. May I continue to meditate on it day and night and let it guide my steps.
In Jesus’ name, I pray, Amen.
